hero.h1: Increasing the accessibility of our programs and the diversity of our community
hero.intro: Our scholarship program extends Dr. Elaine’s™ training to farmers, land stewards, and community leaders who couldn’t otherwise afford it — with priority for applicants working in under-resourced regions where restored soil changes lives fastest.

stories.h2: What a seat in the classroom becomes
stories.note: 2–3 scholarship recipient stories: photo, name, country, one paragraph each. Doubles as donor-facing proof.

steps.body: Tell us about you. A short application: where you are, what you steward, what you’d do with the training.

steps.note: VERIFY review cadence and criteria with the education team.

steps.body: Start learning. Scholars join the same courses, the same community, and the same guarantee as every student.

donorPanel.title: Fund a scholarship
donorPanel.body: Every seat you sponsor puts a trained Soil Regenerator in a community that needs one. Scholarship-designated gifts go directly to student access.
